title: Our content used to show up in Google. Now most of it doesn’t, and I’m running out of ideas.
summary: I run an independent gaming and tech publication established in 2008. Our reviews, previews, hands-on impressions and editorials used to show up in Google. Now most don’t. Some appear briefly, then disappear, while others show under News but nowhere in All. Then we do get some that appear in All, we don't understand why any of this is happening. We used to get 5,000–6,000 visitors a day. Now we’re hitting 2,000–3,000, if that. This has been happening over the past 12 months, but the biggest drop has been in the last 6–7 months. Other publications still appear for the same searches while we don’t. We’ve already: Fixed robots.txt restrictions and a Cloudflare Worker overriding our intended robots.txt. Checked HTTP responses, redirects, canonicals and noindex directives on sampled articles. Changed reviews from NewsArticle to Article, with separate Review schema identifying the game. Cleaned up overlapping theme/plugin schema. AIOSEO handles Article markup. Validated sampled Article, Review, Breadcrumb, Organization and WebSite schema without errors. Updated author profiles, publisher information and breadcrumbs. Used Search Console URL Inspection and requested indexing. Some pages say “Crawled – currently not indexed.” Others are indexed but still don’t show for relevant searches. Investigated Cloudflare restrictions, though we haven’t confirmed verified Googlebot is being blocked. There are no manual actions or penalties reported in Google Search Console. I’ve also been to Google’s support forums, and that wasn’t helpful at all. I’ve pulled out enough hair over this. We’re actually playing these games, testing hardware and writing our own coverage, but I can’t figure out why content that used to appear has practically vanished. What would you investigate next? I need something concrete beyond “check robots.txt, submit a sitemap and write helpful content.” We’ve been going through this for months.   submitted by   /u/unknownhax [link]   [comments]
